output.title: New CertificateRequest revisionHistoryLimit default affects existing Certificates
output.content: v1.18.0 sets the default revisionHistoryLimit for CertificateRequest revisions to 1. The environment has cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests, and the summary does not show whether they set revisionHistoryLimit explicitly. Inspect those Certificates for revisionHistoryLimit and whether any process relies on retaining older CertificateRequest revisions.
